content.short: WIW is a reputation preserving and identity management protocol in Web3.
content.description: WIW is a reputation-preserving identity management protocol in Web3 that uses zero-knowledge proofs to protect user privacy while enabling on-chain reputation. All user data is stored on IPFS, a decentralized file storage system. Users can create profiles on WIW, and a search portal lets anyone query profile tags to view the associated on-chain reputation. Developers can build dApps and infrastructures with WIW’s public and authorized APIs.
